item.title: After a seven year wait, Bandai Namco's classic aerial combat series will return in 2026 with Ace Combat 8
item.description: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve is releasing in 2026, publisher Bandai Namco has revealed. The game, coming to PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S, and PC, was announced during last night's The Game Awards. Read more

item.title: "Littered with falsehoods and disinformation" - game workers union fires back at Rockstar's "lawless attack" once again, after GTA 6 maker's latest attempt to downplay controversial firings
item.description: UK trade union Independent Workers' Union of Great Britain (IWGB) has responded once again in the continuing war of words with GTA 6 developer Rockstar, this time describing the studio's latest statement, on its controversial firing of 34 employees, as an attempt to "reverse engineer a rationale for the dismissals." Read more

item.title: Resident Evil Requiem's Leon and Grace will have differing gameplay like "jumping into a cold bath after a hot sauna"
item.description: Resident Evil Requiem's dual protagonists will represent two styles of gameplay, which its developers describe as like "jumping into a cold bath after a hot sauna". Read more

item.title: Developers at Microsoft-owned Doom studio id Software form union with CWA "to take back control of the industry we love"
item.description: Employees at Doom studio id Software have voted in favour of union representation with the Communications Workers of America (CWA), which has been recognised by Microsoft. Read more

item.title: What we've been playing - "I fell asleep on the sofa after about 20 minutes"
item.description: Hello and welcome back to our regular feature where we write a little bit about some of the games we've been playing. This week a Game of the Year contender put Tom to sleep, Nightreign's DLC posed a real challenge, and Unpacking provides order in a messy world. Read more

item.title: Dispatch dev says there's one super-rare game-state no one's got yet
item.description: Dispatch developer AdHoc has told Eurogamer there's one super-rare game-state that no player has unlocked or achieved yet - something it knows because it has back-end statistics that track these things. Read more

item.title: Matthew McConaughey might have invested in AI voice-generation, but everything you hear in sci-fi RPG Exodus is authentically him
item.description: One of the most headline-grabbing things about science-fiction role-playing game Exodus, beyond it looking a lot like Mass Effect, is that it stars Hollywood actor Matthew McConaughey in his first video game role. He plays the role of C.C. Orlev in the game, a character still shrouded in some mystery, and you can hear his voice narrating the new trailer for the games. Read more

item.title: Rumour has it a new Alien game is on the way and it's being described as "Shadow of the Tomb Raider with xenomorphs"
item.description: Eidos Montreal is reportedly developing a new game based on the Alien franchise. Read more

item.title: French President publicly congratulates Clair Obscur: Expedition 33, calling the Game of The Year win "a historic first"
item.description: French President Emmanuel Macron has once again publicly congratulated Sandfall Interactive for Clair Obscur: Expedition 33, this time for securing a record-breaking nine wins at The Game Awards earlier this week. Read more

item.title: Sledgehammer founder reflects on "bittersweet" changes at EA and Activision: "Watching them fade hits harder than expected"
item.description: Former Striking Distance and Sledgehammer founder Glen Schofield has shared his concerns about the sale of his former employer, EA, saying it's a "bittersweet moment" that reminds him of the sale of Activision to Microsoft. Read more
